description: #53 CRIT-2 and CRIT-3: a private repository at Repair whose Merge ruleset is disabled, so the rules read answers 200 without Merge's rule type and the private item fails, naming the owner-script rerun.

habit_lines: 这个 private 仓库的默认分支上缺少 Merge ruleset 的规则：这个 ruleset 被停用或删除了，规则没有完全生效。
解决办法：habit 运行下面的 owner script 命令，把 ruleset 恢复启用，然后再运行一次治理。
rules_in_effect.issue_line: Rules not in effect on Habit130/tally: the rules on main lack the Merge ruleset's rule types (update), so that ruleset is disabled or gone. Remedy: habit reruns the owner script, which re-enables it.
